title: Cold Today, Sunny Tomorrow
text:
Today is cold and rainy. Anna wears a warm coat, a hat and boots. She also takes an umbrella. Her brother wears a jacket and jeans.

Tomorrow the weather will be sunny. Anna will wear a light dress and sandals. Her brother will wear shorts and a T-shirt. They will go to the park together.

options: A warm coat, a hat and boots

questions.text: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
Why does Anna take an umbrella today?
options: It is probably going to rain

questions.text: How will Anna's brother probably feel tomorrow?

vocabulary.definition: a warm piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear outside
an object you hold above your head to stay dry in the rain
open shoes that you wear in warm weather

paragraph_translations: Hoje está frio e chovendo. Anna usa um casaco quente, um chapéu e botas. Ela também leva um guarda-chuva. Seu irmão usa uma jaqueta e uma calça jeans.
Amanhã o tempo vai estar ensolarado. Anna vai usar um vestido leve e sandálias. Seu irmão vai usar shorts e uma camiseta. Eles vão ao parque juntos.
